profiles: Every pinned projection release. Derived projections apply to all releases. Ordinary single-use WITH is available in PostgreSQL and the pinned MySQL releases from 8.0 onward.
scope: One projection through a single independent nonvolatile SELECT used as a derived table or ordinary single-use CTE. The outer result contains direct local slot reads. The inner projection owns its original external bindings and ordered values.
open: LATERAL, correlated subqueries, nested local scopes, multiple CTEs, recursive CTEs, materialization options, additional outer clauses and local bindings in joined sources

LocalProjection.role: An ordered projection over one independently scoped input
invariants: Definition is an already checked independent SELECT without a row bound or ordering
The nonempty result list has at most 1024 columns
Every result slot belongs to the definition's output
LocalProjection.meaning: Project the named ordered slots over each row of the definition. Preserve typed values, NULLs, repeated input rows and repeated selected slots. The selected positions are independent of spelling or physical table names.
LocalProjection.sql: Assign deterministic unique inner labels by ordinal and emit a derived-table SELECT. Emit the outer labels explicitly. The one-use independent CTE has the same row source under this profile.

LocalResultColumn.role: One result name and ordinal into the scoped definition
invariants: Slot is nonnegative and its local parent requires membership

analysis: Resolve the proven derived-table relation or the exact referenced CTE against the bound facts. Map each resolved output slot by identity and discard analyzed names that do not contribute to the outer result.
observations: Ordered output names and native type tags
Typed multiset of result rows with duplicate and NULL preservation
Reference to the correct local slot even through aliases, reorderings and physical name collisions

finite.completeness: Require the exact Cartesian product of definition and output slot layout from independently observed runtime values.

negative: Definition with local ordering or bounds
Non-column expression in the outer projection
faults: Read the wrong local slot after reordering
Change the definition selected by a one-use binding
trust: Fixed reference interpretation and native name profiles
Independent evaluation of the existing signed projection rules and explicit slot mapping
The registered definition forms have no volatile effects
